name: anamnesis
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — deterministic capture via lifecycle hooks. Per-user encrypted, visible, deletable. 0.4.0 adds zero-token receipts (ADR-070): state-triggered '[anamnesis]' status lines — recall + capture proof-of-work — delivered via hook systemMessage only, never injected into model context (0 tokens, CI-asserted), once per session, with a 'receipts' config key (normal|minimal|off). 0.3.3 fixed the date/time anchor: every prompt carries <current-datetime> with day-of-week, local timezone, and server UTC (local clock as offline fallback), unconditionally. 0.3.2 made Stop capture non-blocking and incremental (background worker, per-transcript high-water mark) and fixed ARG_MAX silent upload failures. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + DCR via 'anamnesis-config'.
